# AliothDigital

> AliothDigital Studios is a London-based business helping UK organisations
> in three ways: COMPETE (bid & tender management), BUILD (recruitment &
> IT staffing), and GROW (digital marketing, web/software development, AI &
> automation, IT support, and creative/content services). The company
> favours clear scope, visible ownership and practical delivery over
> agency jargon.

## Company

- [About](https://aliothdigital.com/about.html): Who AliothDigital is and how the COMPETE/BUILD/GROW model works.
- [Services overview](https://aliothdigital.com/services.html): The three routes (COMPETE, BUILD, GROW) and the specialist services behind each.
- [Work](https://aliothdigital.com/work.html): Selected client case studies (Medecon, BKMA, Smart Flow Engineering, DocAcquire, Centennial Workshop, Bonny Arts, eventezi, Persian Dowry).
- [Insights](https://aliothdigital.com/insights.html): Short practical articles on bidding, hiring and digital work.
- [Contact](https://aliothdigital.com/contact.html): Enquiry form, tender upload, meeting booking, office details.

## COMPETE — Bid & Tender Management

- [Bid & Tender Management](https://aliothdigital.com/bid-development.html): Opportunity review, tender analysis, proposal development, compliance mapping, QA and submission readiness for UK public/private/third-sector procurement.
- [Upload a Tender](https://aliothdigital.com/upload-tender.html): Direct form to send a tender pack, deadline and requirement for review.

## BUILD — Recruitment & Talent

- [Recruitment & IT Staffing](https://aliothdigital.com/recruitment.html): Role definition, targeted sourcing, screening, shortlisting and IT/technology staffing.

## GROW — Digital, Software & IT

- [Software & IT Services (overview)](https://aliothdigital.com/software-it-services.html): The GROW practice umbrella covering all services below.
- [Digital Marketing](https://aliothdigital.com/digital-marketing.html): SEO, content, paid campaigns, analytics, social and email marketing.
- [Web & Software Development](https://aliothdigital.com/web-development.html): Websites, e-commerce, WordPress, custom front-end, API integrations.
- [Web & IT Support](https://aliothdigital.com/web-maintenance.html): Ongoing maintenance, security updates, backups, monitoring, performance.
- [AI & Automation](https://aliothdigital.com/ai-solutions.html): AI assistants, workflow automation, knowledge search, LLM integration, human-in-the-loop systems.
- [Graphic Design / Creative & Content](https://aliothdigital.com/graphic-design.html): Brand identity, presentation decks, brochures, campaign assets.
- [Video Editing](https://aliothdigital.com/video-editing.html): Social, corporate and product video editing, motion graphics.
- [WordPress & Integrations](https://aliothdigital.com/wordpress-plugins.html): Custom plugins, payment gateways, CRM integrations, workflow automation.
